title: ECP Owner Gate Order (M3-RG0 — the ONLY gate-transition instrument)
description: The explicit owner instrument that transitions the registration gate of a trust store (M3-RG0, 0.7.0, order §9/§10). It is the only legal input to apply_owner_gate_order: the seam validates schema, scope binding, ruling completeness and transition legality, then rewrites the authoritative gate state and appends a lineage gate-transition event. All six Owner-bound operational rulings (O-01/O-02/O-04/F-01a/F-01b/POP) MUST be supplied as non-empty strings — an order with a missing value is malformed and refused (fail-closed; the authority never invents Owner decisions). Model execution may not open before the registration gate is open. A development-scope order can never govern an operational-scope trust store (scope binding). Public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records (synthetic development-scope templates, never real owner instruments).

content_class.description: 'review' = real owner instrument (private custody only); 'format-illustration' = synthetic public template (examples/ only).

scope.description: Must equal the trust store scope exactly; a mismatch is rejected.

owner_rulings.description: The complete set of six Owner-bound rulings; nulls are forbidden here — an incomplete order is refused, never completed by inference.

basis.description: Free-text provenance of the owner order this instrument transcribes (owner message / order-of-record citation).
